interpretation: Reject the0.9737909326191059x optimization geometric mean under the strict prospective rule. Gram-Schmidt measures1.04468x, but no case or regression is excluded and no timing retry or holdout run is permitted for this source.
source_changes: Use existing admitted exclusive map banks directly only after checked-source totality and complete-range read guards establish every source body cannot fail and each read is disjoint or reads its own output cell. Unsupported bodies, reverse/cross-cell/partial-overlap inputs and failed version guards retain the exact scratch/copy route.

Preserve current ownership/view publication after complete success. No new runtime layout, pointer lifetime, helper/callback, scalar retirement or per-operation allocation/dispatch. Existing scalar emission and current bank/loan machinery remain shared.

Reuse exact current Bool branch polarity and identity-copy facts to prove synthetic exhaustive-case reject paths unreachable, freshly per element. Reachable reject paths cannot authorize direct writes.

All585 selected checks and both features pass: original/decoded/restored source, all scalar widths/kinds and exact NaN/signedzero bits, actual direct/scratch selection, overlap/reverse reads, late failures, repeated map sites, later scalar first-change calls, source errors, finite denial and atomic recovery.
IR396/work156/ABI47. No benchmark port/input/C/flag/tolerance/finite limit/split/objective/timing-boundary changes. All optimization execution counters match accepted31.
development_failures: attempt-01: totality classifier initially omitted the existing CollectionElement no-op. Reverse/failing paths passed; direct selection was conservatively absent.
attempt-02: exhaustive Bool cases retain a synthetic Reject block. Added bounded current-element Bool flow using shared engine facts rather than treating that unreachable block as a real failure.

attempt-03: an added partial Bool source fixture was correctly rejected by frontend exhaustiveness rules. Corrected the test to assert that contract and separately refuse a compiler-local reachable Reject body. Prior complete qualification/profile was retained under before-final-contract; the final exact source was requalified before its only timing probe.
evidence: Only Gram-Schmidt changes native Object code among optimization15; four guarded maps cover20,600,900 and600 cells. The numeric function grows4286 to4759 instructions.

The final checked profile contains176 canonical execution samples,134 JIT self samples, and only one top-site sample across five scalar-copy-loop candidates. All30 sampled hot instruction/windows and every byte of the profiled numeric function match the actual checked JIT executable page to the genuine Object. Warmup/counters match accepted31.

The optimization probe measures1.04468x in Gram-Schmidt and0.97379x overall, with three regressions>5%. Preserve all data; the static code reduction in copying does not establish an accepted aggregate improvement.
